summary: Polyrizon Ltd., an Israeli clinical-stage biotech listed on Nasdaq (PLRZ), furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 5, 2026 press release announcing a U.S. divisional patent application filed with the USPTO, assigned Application No. 19/823,285 and titled Mucoadhesive Polymers for Nasal Drug Delivery. The filing is an ordinary intellectual-property update expanding the company's mucoadhesive polymer patent family, not a transactional special situation. No stake, price per share, premium, consideration, advisor, board recommendation, ownership split, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch for routine clinical and IP milestones rather than deal-related catalysts.
